data.name: Patterned Weapon
data.description: As a move action, you can transfer the tattoo of one of your powers known onto or off of one manufactured weapon you are wielding.  While on the weapon, you add +%1 to damage rolls made with that weapon.  However, you may not manifest the power represented by the tattoo.|PatternedWeaponDamageBonus
